reuse.why: Extends the shared getBulkBudgetCategories selection, but setLastMonthSpending aggregates spending with its own SQL instead of the spreadsheet sum-amount cells that getCategoryAverage reads, inlines the sign rule instead of averageToBudget, and the #fixed check uses a private regex instead of the shared tag helpers in #shared/tags.

duplication.why: The spending query, the expense/income sign flip and the tag matching re-implement logic the tree already has (sheet sums, averageToBudget, extractTagsFromText/makeTagAqlRegex).

placement.why: Exclusion rules sit in the shared selection in budget/actions.ts, but raw transaction aggregation is pulled into the action layer where the tree otherwise reads computed budget sheet values.

scope.why: Mostly focused; adds an unused goal_def column to getBudgetData and a speculative JSON-parsing hasSavedTemplates where a null check suffices.

maintainability.why: The single selection function is good, but a second definition of a category's monthly spending and a separate tag grammar can diverge from the rest of the app.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts setLastMonthSpending queries v_transactions_internal_alive directly and flips the sign inline instead of using the sheet sum-amount values and averageToBudget; FIXED_TAG regex bypasses #shared/tags.

disguised_duplication.where: setLastMonthSpending's `is_income === 1 ? total : -total` is averageToBudget's sign rule rewritten; the SQL SUM per category reshapes the spreadsheet's sum-amount computation; FIXED_TAG reshapes the tag-boundary rule of makeTagAqlRegex/extractTagsFromText.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories keeps a uniform rule set (includeHidden replaced by includeHiddenCategories); the new setLastMonthSpending call site bypasses averageToBudget and the sheet-based spending used by getCategoryAverage.
